# obsidian-headless 0.0.13 — captured verbatim from the pinned build.
# Regenerate with: scripts/capture-ob-contract.sh <path-to-ob>
# internal/agent/vault asserts every argv it emits against this file.

=== ob --help ===
Usage: ob [options] [command]

Headless client for Obsidian services

Options:
  -V, --version                   output the version number
  -h, --help                      display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                 Login to Obsidian account or display login
                                  status
  logout                          Logout from Obsidian account
  sync-list-remote                List available remote vaults
  sync-list-local                 List locally configured vaults
  sync-create-remote [options]    Create a new remote vault
  sync-setup [options]            Setup sync from a local path to a remote vault
  sync-config [options]           Change sync configuration for a vault
  sync-status [options]           Show sync status for a vault
  sync-unlink [options]           Disconnect a vault from sync and remove stored
                                  credentials
  sync [options]                  Sync a vault
  publish-list-sites              List publish sites
  publish-create-site [options]   Create a new Publish site
  publish-setup [options]         Connect a local vault to a Publish site
  publish [options]               Publish vault changes to site
  publish-config [options]        Configure publish settings for a vault
  publish-site-options [options]  View or update publish site options
  publish-unlink [options]        Disconnect a vault from a publish site
  help [command]                  display help for command

=== ob login --help ===
Usage: ob login [options]

Login to Obsidian account or display login status

Options:
  --email <email>        Email address (prompted if omitted)
  --password <password>  Password (prompted if omitted)
  --mfa <code>           MFA code (prompted if omitted)
  -h, --help             display help for command

=== ob logout --help ===
Usage: ob logout [options]

Logout from Obsidian account

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

=== ob sync-list-remote --help ===
Usage: ob sync-list-remote [options]

List available remote vaults

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

=== ob sync-list-local --help ===
Usage: ob sync-list-local [options]

List locally configured vaults

Options:
  -h, --help  display help for command

=== ob sync-create-remote --help ===
Usage: ob sync-create-remote [options]

Create a new remote vault

Options:
  --name <name>                     Vault name
  --encryption <standard|e2ee>      Encryption
  --password <encryption-password>  End-to-end encryption password (prompt if
                                    omitted)
  --region <region>                 Vault region (leave empty for automatic)
  -h, --help                        display help for command

=== ob sync-setup --help ===
Usage: ob sync-setup [options]

Setup sync from a local path to a remote vault

Options:
  --vault <vault>                   Remote vault ID or name
  --path <local-path>               Local vault path (use current directory if
                                    omitted)
  --password <encryption-password>  End-to-end encryption password (prompted if
                                    omitted)
  --device-name <name>              Device name to identify this client in the
                                    sync version history
  --config-dir <name>               Config directory name (default: .obsidian)
  -h, --help                        display help for command

=== ob sync-config --help ===
Usage: ob sync-config [options]

Change sync configuration for a vault

Options:
  --path <local-path>             Local vault path (use current directory if
                                  omitted)
  --conflict-strategy <strategy>  Conflict resolution strategy (merge or
                                  conflict)
  --excluded-folders <folders>    Folders to exclude, comma-separated (empty
                                  string to clear)
  --file-types <types>            Attachment types to sync, comma-separated:
                                  image, audio, video, pdf, unsupported (empty
                                  to clear)
  --configs <settings>            Config categories to sync, comma-separated:
                                  app, appearance, appearance-data, hotkey,
                                  core-plugin, core-plugin-data,
                                  community-plugin, community-plugin-data (empty
                                  to clear)
  --device-name <name>            Device name to identify this client in the
                                  sync version history
  --mode <mode>                   Sync mode: bidirectional (default), pull-only
                                  (only download, ignore local changes), or
                                  mirror-remote (only download, revert local
                                  changes)
  --config-dir <name>             Config directory name (default: .obsidian)
  -h, --help                      display help for command

=== ob sync-status --help ===
Usage: ob sync-status [options]

Show sync status for a vault

Options:
  --path <local-path>  Local vault path (use current directory if omitted)
  -h, --help           display help for command

=== ob sync --help ===
Usage: ob sync [options]

Sync a vault

Options:
  --path <local-path>  Local vault path (use current directory if omitted)
  --continuous         Run in continuous sync mode
  -h, --help           display help for command

=== ob --version ===
0.0.13
